title: NNNC framework study, stage 2: six entry/exit/stop levers chosen on the early half, tested on four NNNC models
label: PROVISIONAL -- values chosen on early-half (f00-f07) replays/simulations of these models' own trades; the late half (f08-f14) is the out-of-sample test of the choice. Quality gate 2: 2023-26 halves only, no distant era (2022 is inside every model's training window).

screens: diagnose.json (exit/stop levers; 027 replay with the .json operating point; null fidelity ARO 0.999, GBR/GFM >= 0.999, MLX 0.878 < 0.90 -> MLX not screened for exits: its 45 model_exit trades are the only mismatches)
entries.json (entry levers; simulator recall/precision >= 0.998 on all four models)

controls_note: 030 baseline runs (2026-10-12/13) on the current code; they predate this file by design and equal the earlier records 15/15

rule.gain: sum of per-fold return_pct, arm minus its control, over a half
rule.per_model_PASS: early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired verdict (15 folds) maps to pass AND both risk verdicts (Sharpe, maxDD; 15 folds) map to pass
rule.per_model_INCONCLUSIVE: control < min_control_trades, OR the arm changed trades in 0 folds, OR a mapped verdict is inconclusive
rule.switch_ADOPT: PASS on the primary model (ARO) AND PASS on at least replications_needed of GBR, GFM, MLX
rule.combination: run only if >= 2 candidates are ADOPTED: all ADOPTED levers together on the four models, judged by the same rule; if both TP (fixed take-profit) and TK (ATR take-profit) are adopted they conflict -- the combination takes the one with the larger early_sum_pp (TP)
rule.candidate_ADOPT: PASS on ARO AND PASS on at least replications_needed of GBR, GFM, MLX

notes: grace_hours 24, take_profit 0.04, tp_atr_k 4.5 and stop_scale 2.0 are the edges of their screened grids; this tests the chosen value, not the optimum
thr_shift -0.05 lowers every fold's threshold (MLX: its single .json threshold) by 0.05 and so ADDS trades; the screen ignores wallet shrinkage
the screens price levers one at a time, so TP and TK both widen the take-profit and are not independent
reported_only: late-half replay/simulation deltas for the chosen values, computed after this commit
